bib.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)

question: Can multi-head checkpoints be cheaply converted into multi-query or grouped-query models that decode fast without losing most of the multi-head quality?
hypothesis: An intermediate number of key-value heads (GQA) gives quality close to MHA at speed close to MQA, especially for larger models.
contributions: A recipe for uptraining existing multi-head checkpoints into MQA using 5% of original pre-training compute
Grouped-query attention (GQA), an interpolation between multi-head and multi-query attention with an intermediate number of key-value heads

method.summary: Key and value projection matrices of a public T5.1.1 MHA checkpoint are mean-pooled into 1 (MQA) or G (GQA) heads, then the model is pre-trained further for a fraction alpha of the original steps on the original recipe. Models are fine-tuned per task and compared on quality and inference time.
method.task: Encoder-decoder summarization, translation and QA; decoder-inference efficiency

datasets.name: T5 pre-training data (as Raffel et al. 2020)

models.name: MQA-XXL
models.architecture: T5.1.1 XXL, MQA in decoder self-attention and cross-attention, not encoder self-attention
models.init_from: public T5.1.1 XXL checkpoint, K/V heads mean-pooled to one

models.name: GQA-8-XXL
models.architecture: T5.1.1 XXL, 8 groups in decoder self-attention and cross-attention, not encoder self-attention
models.init_from: public T5.1.1 XXL checkpoint, K/V heads mean-pooled within each of 8 groups

training.objective: inferred: T5 pre-training objective (original pre-training setup), then task fine-tuning
training.lr: same as T5 for uptraining; 0.001 constant for fine-tuning
training.lr_schedule: same as T5 for uptraining; constant for fine-tuning
training.steps: alpha proportion of original pre-training steps (alpha = 0.05 main; 0 to 0.1 in Fig 5)
training.epochs: fine-tuning until convergence, best dev checkpoint
training.seq_len: fine-tuning: CNN/DM and WMT 512 in / 256 out; other summarization 2048 / 512; TriviaQA 2048 / 32
training.seeds: MQA models on unstable tasks: average over three fine-tuning runs; otherwise not stated

parameters.timing: 8 TPUs, largest batch that fits up to 32 per TPU, parallelism optimized per model, xprof, time per sample per TPUv4 chip

metrics.name: Average
metrics.definition: mean over the task columns of Table 1 (ROUGE-1, BLEU, F1 mixed)

metrics.name: Tinfer
metrics.definition: time per sample per TPUv4 chip, xprof

eval.protocol: Dev sets; ablations on CNN/Daily Mail, MultiNews and TriviaQA only; MQA on unstable tasks averaged over 3 fine-tuning runs; no significance tests stated

availability.code: Flaxformer (github.com/google/flaxformer) is the base library; no release of this work's code stated

terms.definition: grouped-query attention with G groups; GQA-1 is equivalent to MQA, GQA-H equivalent to MHA
converting the checkpoint, then additional pre-training for a small proportion alpha of original steps so the model adapts to its new structure
